name: Jira → Slack: localized ticket status & release watcher
description: Weekdays 9/12/15/18: status/fix-version changes to #i18n-releases; release alerts with LLR dependencies to #i18n-team; fills Original fix version/date and syncs Target end on LLRs.

parameters.content:
## Localized ticket release watcher
Weekdays 9/12/15/18: product tickets that have an INTERNAT localization (LL) ticket (link "Has localization ticket"): updated in the last 3 days, in an unreleased version, released in the last 14 days, or last seen in an unreleased version.

**Slack (#i18n-releases)**
- Version events (release date moved / released / release reverted): ONE message per version listing all localized tickets in it; later events for the same version reply in that thread.
- Ticket events (status, fix version added/removed, LQA status of the LL ticket): per ticket; first = new post, later = thread reply.

**Slack (#i18n-team)**: alert when a version is released that contains tickets with an LLR; LLRs not Done are flagged.

**Jira**: fills "Original fix version" / "Original release date" on the LL ticket when empty (never overwrites); keeps "Target end" equal to the main ticket's current release date (overwrites manual edits, skips Done LLRs).

First production run of each check only records state. State lives in workflow static data.

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: ={{ 'key in (' + $json.llrKeys.join(',') + ') OR ' + $json.llrKeys.map(k => 'issue in linkedIssues("' + k + '", "is tested by")').join(' OR ') }}

assignments.name: text
assignments.value:
={{ (() => { const d = $('Detect status and release changes').item.json; if (d.kind === 'version') return d.text; const iss = $json.issues || []; const multi = d.llrKeys.length > 1; const st = iss.filter(i => d.llrKeys.includes(i.key) && i.fields && i.fields.customfield_11581 && i.fields.customfield_11581.value).map(i => (multi ? i.key + ' ' : '') + '→ *' + i.fields.customfield_11581.value + '*'); const tp = iss.filter(i => i.fields && i.fields.issuetype && i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan').map(i => '<https://futuremedia.atlassian.net/browse/' + i.key + '|' + i.key + '> → *' + i.fields.status.name + '*' + (i.fields.duedate ? ' (due ' + i.fields.duedate + ')' : '')); let t = d.text; if (st.length) t += '
LQA status ' + st.join(', '); if (tp.length) t += '
LQA ticket: ' + tp.join(', '); if (d.tail) t += '
' + d.tail; return t; })() }}

assignments.name: replyText
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Detect status and release changes').item.json; if (d.kind === 'version') return d.changesText; const iss = $json.issues || []; const multi = d.llrKeys.length > 1; const st = iss.filter(i => d.llrKeys.includes(i.key) && i.fields && i.fields.customfield_11581 && i.fields.customfield_11581.value).map(i => (multi ? i.key + ' ' : '') + '→ *' + i.fields.customfield_11581.value + '*'); const tp = iss.filter(i => i.fields && i.fields.issuetype && i.fields.issuetype.name === 'Test Plan').map(i => '<https://futuremedia.atlassian.net/browse/' + i.key + '|' + i.key + '> → *' + i.fields.status.name + '*'); let t = d.changesText; if (st.length) t += '\nLQA status ' + st.join(', '); if (tp.length) t += '\nLQA ticket: ' + tp.join(', '); return t; })() }}

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: ={{ (function (issues) { const ks = []; (issues || []).forEach(function (i) { ((i.fields || {}).issuelinks || []).forEach(function (l) { if (l.type && l.type.id === '10079' && l.outwardIssue && ks.indexOf(l.outwardIssue.key) < 0) ks.push(l.outwardIssue.key); }); }); return 'project = INTERNAT AND (updated >= -3d' + (ks.length ? ' OR key in (' + ks.join(',') + ')' : '') + ') ORDER BY updated DESC'; })($json.issues) }}
